# The Dynastiest League

> A 10-team dynasty fantasy football league established in 2020, with a $1,000
> annual prize pool. This site is a single-page app whose sections are addressed
> by URL hash; the links below point at each section directly.

The league runs on Sleeper. Roster, matchup, draft, and transaction data is read
live from the public Sleeper API, and trade and draft commentary is generated by
a Cloudflare Worker.

## Sections

- [Home](https://dynastiestleague.com/): League overview, team count, seasons played, and prize pool.
- [Commissioner's Blog](https://dynastiestleague.com/#blog): League news, announcements, and analysis.
- [Teams](https://dynastiestleague.com/#teams): All 10 franchises and their current rosters.
- [Trades](https://dynastiestleague.com/#trades): Completed trades with AI-generated grades and commentary.
- [Draft](https://dynastiestleague.com/#draft): Draft board, pick-by-pick analysis, and per-team draft grades.
- [Scouting](https://dynastiestleague.com/#scouting): Scouting reports and player evaluation.
- [Hall of Records](https://dynastiestleague.com/#records): All-time records, statistics, and past champions.
- [Current Champion](https://dynastiestleague.com/#champion): The reigning champion and season highlights.
- [Previous Seasons](https://dynastiestleague.com/#previous-seasons): Standings and results from prior seasons.
- [League Constitution](https://dynastiestleague.com/#constitution): Rules, scoring, roster settings, draft procedures, trade policy, and playoff structure.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://dynastiestleague.com/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable list of indexable URLs.
- [robots.txt](https://dynastiestleague.com/robots.txt): Crawler directives.
- [Source code](https://github.com/jason-shprintz/dynastiest-league): The repository behind this site.
